meta.title: Repaid In Hate - 2
meta.description: Vengeful thoughts coalesce, like the raging downpour.

units.rawText: A gust of wind shatters the various defensive devices lining the passageway and crushes the never-ending stream of arrows Alcyone is firing. The brutal demon presses closer, step by step, and all the girl can do is retreat.
units.displayText: A gust of wind shatters the various defensive devices lining the passageway and crushes the never-ending stream of arrows Alcyone is firing. The brutal demon presses closer, step by step, and all the girl can do is retreat.

spans.text: A gust of wind shatters the various defensive devices lining the passageway and crushes the never-ending stream of arrows Alcyone is firing. The brutal demon presses closer, step by step, and all the girl can do is retreat.

units.rawText: (Pants heavily)
units.displayText: Pants heavily

spans.text: Pants heavily

units.rawText: Useless! Useless! Useless! Is that all the strength your anger can give you?
units.displayText: Useless! Useless! Useless! Is that all the strength your anger can give you?

spans.text: Useless! Useless! Useless! Is that all the strength your anger can give you?

units.rawText: Weren't you going to secure the Watchtower? Weren't you going to avenge Atlas?
units.displayText: Weren't you going to secure the Watchtower? Weren't you going to avenge Atlas?

spans.text: Weren't you going to secure the Watchtower? Weren't you going to avenge Atlas?

units.rawText: <size=40>This is NOWHERE near enough for that!</size>
units.displayText: This is NOWHERE near enough for that!

spans.text: This is NOWHERE near enough for that!

units.rawText: <size=40>Urgh—</size>
units.displayText: Urgh—

spans.text: Urgh—

units.rawText: Caina catches up with Alcyone. A sweep of her longsword sends the girl flying aside with a groan.
units.displayText: Caina catches up with Alcyone. A sweep of her longsword sends the girl flying aside with a groan.

spans.text: Caina catches up with Alcyone. A sweep of her longsword sends the girl flying aside with a groan.

units.rawText: Alcyone crashes heavily into the wall, and blue coolant drips down its surface.
units.displayText: Alcyone crashes heavily into the wall, and blue coolant drips down its surface.

spans.text: Alcyone crashes heavily into the wall, and blue coolant drips down its surface.

units.rawText: As the dust clears, the girl stumbles back to her feet.
units.displayText: As the dust clears, the girl stumbles back to her feet.

spans.text: As the dust clears, the girl stumbles back to her feet.

units.rawText: Ca..i..na... you... deserve... death...
units.displayText: Ca..i..na... you... deserve... death...

spans.text: Ca..i..na... you... deserve... death...

units.rawText: <size=40>Too weak! Too damn weak! Come on and burn! Burn with anger! Burn with wrath! Burn with the will to fight!</size>
units.displayText: Too weak! Too damn weak! Come on and burn! Burn with anger! Burn with wrath! Burn with the will to fight!

spans.text: Too weak! Too damn weak! Come on and burn! Burn with anger! Burn with wrath! Burn with the will to fight!

units.rawText: If you don't, you're dead!
units.displayText: If you don't, you're dead!

spans.text: If you don't, you're dead!

units.rawText: Caina's smile turns savage and she advances again, her weapon held high.
units.displayText: Caina's smile turns savage and she advances again, her weapon held high.

spans.text: Caina's smile turns savage and she advances again, her weapon held high.

units.rawText: Opposite her is Alcyone, who exhales a trembling breath before quickly stepping back and drawing her bow.
units.displayText: Opposite her is Alcyone, who exhales a trembling breath before quickly stepping back and drawing her bow.

spans.text: Opposite her is Alcyone, who exhales a trembling breath before quickly stepping back and drawing her bow.

units.rawText: <size=40>JUDGEMENT ARROW!</size>
units.displayText: JUDGEMENT ARROW!

spans.text: JUDGEMENT ARROW!

units.rawText: Is this your last gasp? What a shame.
units.displayText: Is this your last gasp? What a shame.

spans.text: Is this your last gasp? What a shame.

units.rawText: <size=40>This is it, Sanctifier! Time to die!</size>
units.displayText: This is it, Sanctifier! Time to die!

spans.text: This is it, Sanctifier! Time to die!

units.rawText: Thunk—
units.displayText: Thunk—

spans.text: Thunk—

units.rawText: An arrow sinks into Caina's chest. The High-Order Entropic cannot block it. Keen arcs of operands have raced past her sides at some point, and the sword that should have been raised high falls to the ground with her arms.
units.displayText: An arrow sinks into Caina's chest. The High-Order Entropic cannot block it. Keen arcs of operands have raced past her sides at some point, and the sword that should have been raised high falls to the ground with her arms.

spans.text: An arrow sinks into Caina's chest. The High-Order Entropic cannot block it. Keen arcs of operands have raced past her sides at some point, and the sword that should have been raised high falls to the ground with her arms.

units.rawText: She stops in her tracks for a moment before looking down. Then, she slowly shuffles left and right, as though to confirm the baffling reality that confronts her.
units.displayText: She stops in her tracks for a moment before looking down. Then, she slowly shuffles left and right, as though to confirm the baffling reality that confronts her.

spans.text: She stops in her tracks for a moment before looking down. Then, she slowly shuffles left and right, as though to confirm the baffling reality that confronts her.

units.rawText: What's... going... urgh—?
units.displayText: What's... going... urgh—?

spans.text: What's... going... urgh—?

units.rawText: Thunk—
units.displayText: Thunk—

spans.text: Thunk—

units.rawText: Another arrow strikes home.
units.displayText: Another arrow strikes home.

spans.text: Another arrow strikes home.

units.rawText: Thunk—
units.displayText: Thunk—

spans.text: Thunk—

units.rawText: Yet another arrow.
units.displayText: Yet another arrow.

spans.text: Yet another arrow.

units.rawText: Alcyone is advancing, Caina is retreating.
units.displayText: Alcyone is advancing, Caina is retreating.

spans.text: Alcyone is advancing, Caina is retreating.

units.rawText: Thud—
units.displayText: Thud—

spans.text: Thud—

units.rawText: The wretched High-Order Entropic falls on her butt, and three figures appear along the edges of her vision.
units.displayText: The wretched High-Order Entropic falls on her butt, and three figures appear along the edges of her vision.

spans.text: The wretched High-Order Entropic falls on her butt, and three figures appear along the edges of her vision.

units.rawText: The female Sanctifier's hands are still wreathed with smoldering operands. Caina's severed arms were her doing.
units.displayText: The female Sanctifier's hands are still wreathed with smoldering operands. Caina's severed arms were her doing.

spans.text: The female Sanctifier's hands are still wreathed with smoldering operands. Caina's severed arms were her doing.

units.rawText: She's the only one. I didn't see any other High-Order Entropics.
units.displayText: She's the only one. I didn't see any other High-Order Entropics.

spans.text: She's the only one. I didn't see any other High-Order Entropics.

units.rawText: Being able to eliminate one is good enough. The worst-case scenario would be if they all decided to stake out one of the towers to ambush us.
units.displayText: Being able to eliminate one is good enough. The worst-case scenario would be if they all decided to stake out one of the towers to ambush us.

spans.text: Being able to eliminate one is good enough. The worst-case scenario would be if they all decided to stake out one of the towers to ambush us.

units.rawText: Thank you for your hard work, Alcyone. You did well.
units.displayText: Thank you for your hard work, Alcyone. You did well.

spans.text: Thank you for your hard work, Alcyone. You did well.

units.rawText: Not well enough.
units.displayText: Not well enough.

spans.text: Not well enough.

units.rawText: <color=red>Eosphorus? Eos? <cmdr>?! Why? Why are you all here?!</color>
units.displayText: Eosphorus? Eos? {교수}?! Why? Why are you all here?!

spans.text: Eosphorus? Eos?
?! Why? Why are you all here?!

units.rawText: <color=red>What the hell is this... Jellyfish said you'd split up! You need to split up to take all three Watchtowers!</color>
units.displayText: What the hell is this... Jellyfish said you'd split up! You need to split up to take all three Watchtowers!

spans.text: What the hell is this... Jellyfish said you'd split up! You need to split up to take all three Watchtowers!

units.rawText: <color=red>If you didn't leave, then why didn't you come out from the beginning? Why didn't you face me fair and square! Why didn't you look me in the eye and fight me?!</color>
units.displayText: If you didn't leave, then why didn't you come out from the beginning? Why didn't you face me fair and square! Why didn't you look me in the eye and fight me?!

spans.text: If you didn't leave, then why didn't you come out from the beginning? Why didn't you face me fair and square! Why didn't you look me in the eye and fight me?!

units.rawText: Because we weren't sure that you'd be the only one attacking this Watchtower.
units.displayText: Because we weren't sure that you'd be the only one attacking this Watchtower.

spans.text: Because we weren't sure that you'd be the only one attacking this Watchtower.

units.rawText: In contrast to Caina's hysterics, Alcyone calmly wipes away the coolant speckling in the corner of her mouth and walks toward her. Her gait is unsteady, her head is lowered, and instead of looking her in the eyes, her face is blank. The lighting seems to have changed, because it veils her face in shadow.
units.displayText: In contrast to Caina's hysterics, Alcyone calmly wipes away the coolant speckling in the corner of her mouth and walks toward her. Her gait is unsteady, her head is lowered, and instead of looking her in the eyes, her face is blank. The lighting seems to have changed, because it veils her face in shadow.

spans.text: In contrast to Caina's hysterics, Alcyone calmly wipes away the coolant speckling in the corner of her mouth and walks toward her. Her gait is unsteady, her head is lowered, and instead of looking her in the eyes, her face is blank. The lighting seems to have changed, because it veils her face in shadow.

units.rawText: Eosphorus told us that this was your home ground. After we took one tower, you'd naturally know where else the Sanctifiers would be headed.
units.displayText: Eosphorus told us that this was your home ground. After we took one tower, you'd naturally know where else the Sanctifiers would be headed.

spans.text: Eosphorus told us that this was your home ground. After we took one tower, you'd naturally know where else the Sanctifiers would be headed.

units.rawText: In that case, why not play to your expectations and pretend to split up? That way, we could all defend this place and use your misconceptions to take out at least one of you.
units.displayText: In that case, why not play to your expectations and pretend to split up? That way, we could all defend this place and use your misconceptions to take out at least one of you.

spans.text: In that case, why not play to your expectations and pretend to split up? That way, we could all defend this place and use your misconceptions to take out at least one of you.

units.rawText: Fortunately, if there WAS a High-Order Entropic who'd fall into the trap, it would probably be you, the one who likes charging headlong into things. Unfortunately, just as we predicted, if any High-Order Entropic fell for it, then it would have to be you.
units.displayText: Fortunately, if there WAS a High-Order Entropic who'd fall into the trap, it would probably be you, the one who likes charging headlong into things. Unfortunately, just as we predicted, if any High-Order Entropic fell for it, then it would have to be you.

spans.text: Fortunately, if there WAS a High-Order Entropic who'd fall into the trap, it would probably be you, the one who likes charging headlong into things. Unfortunately, just as we predicted, if any High-Order Entropic fell for it, then it would have to be you.

units.rawText: <color=red>(Pants) Ambushes, always with the ambushes. How can you do this? How can you keep doing this?</color>
units.displayText: (Pants) Ambushes, always with the ambushes. How can you do this? How can you keep doing this?

spans.text: (Pants) Ambushes, always with the ambushes. How can you do this? How can you keep doing this?

units.rawText: <color=red>Whether it's you Sanctifiers or Jellyfish, your heads are all filled with twisty, twirly crap—</color>
units.displayText: Whether it's you Sanctifiers or Jellyfish, your heads are all filled with twisty, twirly crap—

spans.text: Whether it's you Sanctifiers or Jellyfish, your heads are all filled with twisty, twirly crap—

units.rawText: Caina's voice is still trembling as it trails off, but her body has already relaxed from its tensed state.
units.displayText: Caina's voice is still trembling as it trails off, but her body has already relaxed from its tensed state.

spans.text: Caina's voice is still trembling as it trails off, but her body has already relaxed from its tensed state.

units.rawText: Alcyone forcefully stabs the arrow she is holding through her chest. Her wrath spent, the High-Order Entropic crashes heavily to the ground, throwing up a cloud of dust.
units.displayText: Alcyone forcefully stabs the arrow she is holding through her chest. Her wrath spent, the High-Order Entropic crashes heavily to the ground, throwing up a cloud of dust.

spans.text: Alcyone forcefully stabs the arrow she is holding through her chest. Her wrath spent, the High-Order Entropic crashes heavily to the ground, throwing up a cloud of dust.

units.rawText: Alcyone, can you still function? Are you alright? Perhaps you should let me...
units.displayText: Alcyone, can you still function? Are you alright? Perhaps you should let me...

spans.text: Alcyone, can you still function? Are you alright? Perhaps you should let me...

units.rawText: I'm fine, Eos. It's just a scratch, and the repair sectors inside the Watchtower are still usable. Don't waste time on healing me.
units.displayText: I'm fine, Eos. It's just a scratch, and the repair sectors inside the Watchtower are still usable. Don't waste time on healing me.

spans.text: I'm fine, Eos. It's just a scratch, and the repair sectors inside the Watchtower are still usable. Don't waste time on healing me.

units.rawText: You guys should head out. Although there's no avoiding battle at the other two Watchtowers, the longer you delay, the more the Entropics can prepare to face you.
units.displayText: You guys should head out. Although there's no avoiding battle at the other two Watchtowers, the longer you delay, the more the Entropics can prepare to face you.

spans.text: You guys should head out. Although there's no avoiding battle at the other two Watchtowers, the longer you delay, the more the Entropics can prepare to face you.

units.rawText: I know. Please don't push yourself. If there's really nothing you can do...
units.displayText: I know. Please don't push yourself. If there's really nothing you can do...

spans.text: I know. Please don't push yourself. If there's really nothing you can do...

units.rawText: Have some faith in her, Eos. She's your comrade, a powerful Greater Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Have some faith in her, Eos. She's your comrade, a powerful Greater Sanctifier.

spans.text: Have some faith in her, Eos. She's your comrade, a powerful Greater Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Alcyone, I'm entrusting this Watchtower and Electra to you.
units.displayText: Alcyone, I'm entrusting this Watchtower and Electra to you.

spans.text: Alcyone, I'm entrusting this Watchtower and Electra to you.

units.rawText: According to the reports from the frontline units, there shouldn't be any more High-Order Entropics in Tartarus. You'll only have to face ordinary Entropics after this.
units.displayText: According to the reports from the frontline units, there shouldn't be any more High-Order Entropics in Tartarus. You'll only have to face ordinary Entropics after this.

spans.text: According to the reports from the frontline units, there shouldn't be any more High-Order Entropics in Tartarus. You'll only have to face ordinary Entropics after this.

units.rawText: Understood. I will hold the Watchtower and ensure the Halo system operates normally. You don't have to worry.
units.displayText: Understood. I will hold the Watchtower and ensure the Halo system operates normally. You don't have to worry.

spans.text: Understood. I will hold the Watchtower and ensure the Halo system operates normally. You don't have to worry.

units.rawText: As the group exchanges information and verifies the situation while giving each other reminders, Caina twitches imperceptibly where she's lying on the ground.
units.displayText: As the group exchanges information and verifies the situation while giving each other reminders, Caina twitches imperceptibly where she's lying on the ground.

spans.text: As the group exchanges information and verifies the situation while giving each other reminders, Caina twitches imperceptibly where she's lying on the ground.

units.rawText: Her stalled systems begin functioning again, and faint traces of operands start to gather
units.displayText: Her stalled systems begin functioning again, and faint traces of operands start to gather

spans.text: Her stalled systems begin functioning again, and faint traces of operands start to gather

units.rawText: <color=red>(I'm so pissed I'm so pissed I'm so pissed!)</color>
units.displayText: I'm so pissed I'm so pissed I'm so pissed!

spans.text: I'm so pissed I'm so pissed I'm so pissed!

units.rawText: The sound of Caina grinding her teeth echoes through her neural cloud.
units.displayText: The sound of Caina grinding her teeth echoes through her neural cloud.

spans.text: The sound of Caina grinding her teeth echoes through her neural cloud.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, the operand levels within Caina's body begin climbing as her emotions build.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, the operand levels within Caina's body begin climbing as her emotions build.

spans.text: Meanwhile, the operand levels within Caina's body begin climbing as her emotions build.

units.rawText: <color=red>(They're all like this, each and every one of them!)</color>
units.displayText: They're all like this, each and every one of them!

spans.text: They're all like this, each and every one of them!

units.rawText: <color=red>(Those cheap Sanctifiers... What right do they have to look down on me and ignore me?! They don't even dare to fight me fair and square!!)</color>
units.displayText: Those cheap Sanctifiers... What right do they have to look down on me and ignore me?! They don't even dare to fight me fair and square!!

spans.text: Those cheap Sanctifiers... What right do they have to look down on me and ignore me?! They don't even dare to fight me fair and square!!

units.rawText: <color=red><size=40>Even if I have to die here... I'll make damn sure I drag you down to hell with me!</size></color>
units.displayText: Even if I have to die here... I'll make damn sure I drag you down to hell with me!

spans.text: Even if I have to die here... I'll make damn sure I drag you down to hell with me!

units.rawText: Eos reflexively reaches out to them, but Eosphorus stops her.
units.displayText: Eos reflexively reaches out to them, but Eosphorus stops her.

spans.text: Eos reflexively reaches out to them, but Eosphorus stops her.

units.rawText: Having gathered her strength, Caina suddenly bursts into motion and springs up, her twisted face headed straight for the back of Alcyone's neck.
units.displayText: Having gathered her strength, Caina suddenly bursts into motion and springs up, her twisted face headed straight for the back of Alcyone's neck.

spans.text: Having gathered her strength, Caina suddenly bursts into motion and springs up, her twisted face headed straight for the back of Alcyone's neck.

units.rawText: As it happens, Alcyone is turning to face her, and her eyes meet Caina's through the blindfold over the latter's eyes.
units.displayText: As it happens, Alcyone is turning to face her, and her eyes meet Caina's through the blindfold over the latter's eyes.

spans.text: As it happens, Alcyone is turning to face her, and her eyes meet Caina's through the blindfold over the latter's eyes.

units.rawText: Faced with Caina's sudden lunge, Alcyone does not panic, does not freeze up, and certainly does not collapse. Her face is still blank; only the slight twitching of her cheeks reveals that she is clenching her teeth under her even lips.
units.displayText: Faced with Caina's sudden lunge, Alcyone does not panic, does not freeze up, and certainly does not collapse. Her face is still blank; only the slight twitching of her cheeks reveals that she is clenching her teeth under her even lips.

spans.text: Faced with Caina's sudden lunge, Alcyone does not panic, does not freeze up, and certainly does not collapse. Her face is still blank; only the slight twitching of her cheeks reveals that she is clenching her teeth under her even lips.

units.rawText: The only other response the girl makes is to forcefully throw a punch in a way that Caina seems to recall seeing not long ago.
units.displayText: The only other response the girl makes is to forcefully throw a punch in a way that Caina seems to recall seeing not long ago.

spans.text: The only other response the girl makes is to forcefully throw a punch in a way that Caina seems to recall seeing not long ago.

units.rawText: Whooshwhooshwhooshwhooshwhoosh—
units.displayText: Whooshwhooshwhooshwhooshwhoosh—

spans.text: Whooshwhooshwhooshwhooshwhoosh—

units.rawText: A rapid series of whistling noises fills the air as the devices hidden above the group bare their fangs. Over a dozen arrow shafts turn the resurgent Caina into a porcupine and extinguish the raging operands within her.
units.displayText: A rapid series of whistling noises fills the air as the devices hidden above the group bare their fangs. Over a dozen arrow shafts turn the resurgent Caina into a porcupine and extinguish the raging operands within her.

spans.text: A rapid series of whistling noises fills the air as the devices hidden above the group bare their fangs. Over a dozen arrow shafts turn the resurgent Caina into a porcupine and extinguish the raging operands within her.

units.rawText: Alcyone, you...
units.displayText: Alcyone, you...

spans.text: Alcyone, you...

units.rawText: Eos, <cmdr>, let's go. We ought to get moving.
units.displayText: Eos, {교수}, let's go. We ought to get moving.

spans.text: Eos,
, let's go. We ought to get moving.

units.rawText: Eos is still looking worriedly at her as I tug on her, and we leave the Watchtower with Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Eos is still looking worriedly at her as I tug on her, and we leave the Watchtower with Eosphorus.

spans.text: Eos is still looking worriedly at her as I tug on her, and we leave the Watchtower with Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Behind her, the petite girl... No, the Greater Sanctifier is still glaring at Caina. She has not looked away even once.
units.displayText: Behind her, the petite girl... No, the Greater Sanctifier is still glaring at Caina. She has not looked away even once.

spans.text: Behind her, the petite girl... No, the Greater Sanctifier is still glaring at Caina. She has not looked away even once.

units.rawText: I even had two more surprises ready for you, though I don't know if you can get up again to see them.
units.displayText: I even had two more surprises ready for you, though I don't know if you can get up again to see them.

spans.text: I even had two more surprises ready for you, though I don't know if you can get up again to see them.

units.rawText: Given how cocky you are, I'm sure you must be able to take quite the pounding.
units.displayText: Given how cocky you are, I'm sure you must be able to take quite the pounding.

spans.text: Given how cocky you are, I'm sure you must be able to take quite the pounding.

units.rawText: A moment later, as though thinking that her gesture was pointless, or perhaps just out of concern for Electra in the repair bay, Alcyone takes out an arrow and stabs it down, straight through Caina's skull.
units.displayText: A moment later, as though thinking that her gesture was pointless, or perhaps just out of concern for Electra in the repair bay, Alcyone takes out an arrow and stabs it down, straight through Caina's skull.

spans.text: A moment later, as though thinking that her gesture was pointless, or perhaps just out of concern for Electra in the repair bay, Alcyone takes out an arrow and stabs it down, straight through Caina's skull.

units.rawText: After watching Caina's body disintegrate into a sticky puddle of Liquid Entropy, Alcyone turns and heads into the depths of the Watchtower without looking back.
units.displayText: After watching Caina's body disintegrate into a sticky puddle of Liquid Entropy, Alcyone turns and heads into the depths of the Watchtower without looking back.

spans.text: After watching Caina's body disintegrate into a sticky puddle of Liquid Entropy, Alcyone turns and heads into the depths of the Watchtower without looking back.

units.rawText: Did you see that, Atlas? I can take revenge on my own.
units.displayText: Did you see that, Atlas? I can take revenge on my own.

spans.text: Did you see that, Atlas? I can take revenge on my own.

units.rawText: The girl pats the badge through her clothing and mutters quietly to herself as she walks through the Watchtower.
units.displayText: The girl pats the badge through her clothing and mutters quietly to herself as she walks through the Watchtower.

spans.text: The girl pats the badge through her clothing and mutters quietly to herself as she walks through the Watchtower.

units.rawText: <color=red>I'm back, Electra.</color>
units.displayText: I'm back, Electra.

spans.text: I'm back, Electra.

units.rawText: I figured she might have a surprise in store for us, so I activated the appropriate defenses beforehand. I can't lose anyone else because of my miscalculations.
units.displayText: I figured she might have a surprise in store for us, so I activated the appropriate defenses beforehand. I can't lose anyone else because of my miscalculations.

spans.text: I figured she might have a surprise in store for us, so I activated the appropriate defenses beforehand. I can't lose anyone else because of my miscalculations.

units.rawText: Thank you for your faith in me, Lord Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Thank you for your faith in me, Lord Eosphorus.

spans.text: Thank you for your faith in me, Lord Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Eosphorus nods to Alcyone in approval.
units.displayText: Eosphorus nods to Alcyone in approval.

spans.text: Eosphorus nods to Alcyone in approval.
